question: Do hierarchical summarize-then-synthesize pipelines risk dropping methodological limitations early, according to the notes?
required_claim: Yes: early summaries can omit limitations, which then never reach the final synthesis.

passages.text: A vending machine on Floor 2 was restocked with water bottles.
The language lab headphones were sanitized between classes.
An intramural soccer match was rescheduled after rain.
Pipeline note N: When each paper is compressed into a short summary first, methodological limitations are frequently dropped because they are not treated as central claims.
The post office window shortened lunch-hour service.
Pipeline note O: If a limitation is missing from stage-1 summaries, later synthesis stages cannot recover it unless the system re-reads the source or keeps an explicit evidence table.
A visitor parking voucher printer was installed at Gate B.
